notes: Commit fb3336f fixes most of the unit problems from the last review. For a tour booked in the dashboard, status lines now use the band's units ('Goes ahead with 240 fans; still selling', 'Missed its target of 200 fans'). Feed events are written as fans and euros ('Target reached with 240 of 400 fans', 'Paid out €4,800: you …'). The wizard preview shows what will actually be booked ('up to 800 fans (room 1,600)'), and the full-house money is worked out from the same capped capacity, with a note when the band's draw is bigger. The show page now says 'Sales close in' and 'Show in', and has a 'Copy link for fans' button. On a phone the nav wraps onto two rows, so every page can be reached, and the second logo is gone. Approvals now sends a band with a running tour to 'Follow your tour'. The phone sweep now runs as a connected band with a booked tour, and the wizard has been captured at 390 px. What still works well: the public screen, the single 'Create your first tour' button, the four questions with sensible defaults, and the route preview with the money shown before anything is booked. The score stays below 8.5 for four reasons. First, a new visible bug: the clock ticks up from 0 before the chain time arrives, so the phone dashboard says 'sales close in 20735d' and 'show in 20735d' (phone-booked-dashboard.png); on a slow network this is the first thing a band sees. Second, the 'let it run' part still contradicts itself. On Activity, a tour with 320 fans and a confirmed show says 'Your shows are booked; nothing else has happened yet' (phone-feed.png). The dashboard swaps that for a 'Reading the story… it can take a minute' message that never resolves when no events come back. The show page puts 'Ticket purchases (0)' and an empty table under '80 / 400 fans'. Third, the phone shell stretches the nav row to fill the screen height, which leaves a 120–260 px empty band under the nav on Activity, Approvals and Planner. Fourth, the feed now always speaks in euros and fans, so a tour booked by the agents and priced in real SOL would show refunds of thousands of euros. Older friction is untouched. The booked dashboard repeats the same three shows in four forms. The wallet strip with SOL, 'Settled shows' and 'Tickets you hold' still sits above 'Your band is on-chain' on the no-tour screen. Band record and registration still use SOL, rent and tickets. Book can still be tapped twice, the price input still clamps on every keystroke, every tour still starts in Berlin with unexplained days off, the planner overwrites the band's sketch with no undo, the running tour vanishes after a second booking, and phone Venues is still 10,500 px long.
issues: packages/web/src/app/page.tsx:30,87 + app/show/page.tsx:35,69 + lib/format.ts:27: `now` starts at 0 and the 1 s tick runs setNow(n => n + 1) before chainTime() resolves. timeLeft only guards !now, so the band sees 'sales close in 20735d' / 'show in 20735d' until the RPC answers (phone-booked-dashboard.png), and longer on slow networks. Fix: tick only once the clock is set (setNow(n => n ? n + 1 : 0)), or seed now with Math.floor(Date.now()/1000) and correct it from chainTime.

packages/web/src/app/feed/page.tsx:79 + app/page.tsx:407 + components/Feed.tsx:121: when no events come back, Activity says 'Your shows are booked; nothing else has happened yet' next to 320 fans and a confirmed show (phone-feed.png). The dashboard says 'Reading the story so far… it can take a minute', which never resolves (7-booked-dashboard.png). The compact feed the band asked for is never shown for its own tour in any screenshot. Fix: when events are empty, build feed lines from the show accounts already loaded ('Hamburg: 240 fans, going ahead'; 'Leipzig: waiting for the venue to sign'), grouped like the event categories, and use the same empty text on both pages.

packages/web/src/app/globals.css:83-87,1091-1100: at 390 px the single-column .shell keeps min-height:100vh, and the grid stretches the auto sidebar row, so short pages get a 120–260 px empty band between the nav and the content (phone-feed.png, phone-approvals.png, phone-planner.png). Fix: in the 896 px query set `.shell { grid-template-rows: auto 1fr; }` (or align-content: start).

packages/web/src/lib/chain-live.ts:111-127 (describe): feed lines now always use fans(n) and euros(), but cards and stats switch on run.inApp. A tour booked by the agents (--band-keypair, priced in real SOL, 1 ticket = 1 ticket) would read 'A fan bought… 20 more fans' and refunds of about €11,400 for 0.0057 SOL. Fix: pass the tour's inApp flag into fetchShowEvents/describe and keep tickets/SOL wording for those tours.

packages/web/src/app/show/page.tsx:280-305: the band's own show page shows 'Ticket purchases (0)' with an empty header-only table under '80 / 400 fans' (8-own-show.png), because ticket accounts cannot be listed on public RPCs. Fix: for the band, hide the table or show an empty state ('The fan list is not available on public devnet; 80 fans have bought so far'); show the table only when it has rows.

packages/web/src/app/page.tsx:323-380: after booking, the same three shows still appear four times: the stepper, five stat tiles, the itinerary with badges, and the Shows grid. On a phone the route starts about 800 px down and the grid repeats it (phone-booked-dashboard.png). Fix: one summary line plus the itinerary, with each stop's progress bar inline and the card opening on tap; drop the separate Shows grid.

packages/web/src/app/page.tsx:115-121,461 + components/WalletPanel.tsx:70-80: the no-tour screen (2-connected.png) still opens with a chain strip (wallet address, '1.5 SOL devnet', 'Settled shows', 'Tickets you hold') above the band name, and says 'Your band is on-chain.' The booked dashboard repeats the strip at the bottom. Fix: render the panel below the CTA (or in the wallet button's menu), drop 'Tickets you hold' and SOL from the band view, and write 'You're set up. Time for the first tour.'

packages/web/src/app/tour/new/page.tsx:92-96: book() still calls setBusy only through bookTour's onStatus, after the dynamic import, the profile fetch and the instruction builds, so 'Book this tour' stays enabled for a second or more and a double tap starts two bookings. Fix: setBusy('Preparing…') as the first line of book().

packages/web/src/app/band/page.tsx:74-91 + components/Connect.tsx:101,104,112-114: the band record still shows 'Settled shows', 'Tickets sold' (sample count), 'Gross settled' in SOL and 'profile ↗' (phone-band.png). Registration says 'registered on-chain' and 'rent (about 0.002 SOL)', and shows raw error.message. Fix: 'Played shows', fans and euros for app tours, 'a small deposit', and pass errors through bookingErrorText.

packages/web/src/app/tour/new/page.tsx:173: the custom price still clamps on every keystroke (Number('') || 1), so deleting '20' to type '35' gives 1 and then 13. Fix: keep the raw string in state and clamp on blur or on Plan my tour.

packages/web/src/app/tour/new/page.tsx:20 + lib/book.ts (planFromAnswers): every band starts in Berlin, and the route is take-it-or-leave-it. In 4-route-preview.png Berlin is followed by '4 days off' before a 179 km drive, and the route doubles back from Leipzig north to Hamburg, with no explanation and no way to drop a stop. Fix: remember the last start city, say why a gap exists ('no free room in Leipzig before Nov 8'), and allow per-stop toggles like the Approvals route card.

packages/web/src/app/tour/new/page.tsx:261-264: the line under 'Book this tour' still leads with chain units ('about 0.005 SOL per show', '€30 = 0.0003 SOL of play money'), right where the band decides. Fix: 'Your wallet asks once and pays a small refundable deposit (under €1 in this demo)', with the SOL figures behind a 'Details' disclosure.

packages/web/src/lib/chain-live.ts:70 + app/tour/new/page.tsx:144-148: booking a second tour is warned about, but the running tour then disappears from the dashboard (only toursCreated-1 is read), and there is no way back to it. Fix: list earlier tours under the current one ('Running and past tours') with links, or keep the dashboard on the tour with live shows.

packages/web/src/app/planner/page.tsx:112-134,224-234: 'Open in route planner →' (?from=tour) still overwrites the band's saved sketch through savePlan, and the planner reschedules with its own rest rule, so the dates differ from the dashboard. 'Load my tour' and 'Clear' wipe the plan with no undo. Fix: keep the tour's real days, and add an undo toast.

packages/web/src/app/venues/page.tsx:229 + phone-venues.png: phone Venues is still one 10,500 px list of every city under two filter toolbars, and 'No venues match these filters.' offers no reset. Fix: collapse each city to one row that opens on tap, put the filters behind a single 'Filter' button on phones, and add 'Clear filters' to the empty state.

packages/web/src/components/Shell.tsx:17-24 + components/Approvals.tsx:390: Approvals stays a permanent nav item for wizard-booked tours, which never have anything pending, and the agent flow still says 'The offer lapses in about 287s'. Fix: show Approvals in the nav only while something is pending or for agent-run bands, and format the countdown as '~5 min'.

qa/src/ui-bot.ts:51,436-445: the phone sweep now runs as a connected band, but it still never captures the wizard's route preview, the band's own show page or a non-empty own-band Activity at 390 px. The fake RPC returns [] for getSignaturesForAddress, so the band's feed categories are never exercised. Fix: add /tour/new after Plan my tour and /show?address=… to the phone sweep, and return a few signed events from the fake RPC.
